title: Monday Morning Quarterback (on Sunday)
date_line: Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026. College Saturday review: the Nov. 14 slate, graded, plus Illinois at UCLA and Houston at Colorado from Friday night (Nov. 13). Three late games are still being played and get graded in the next update. Then what's next.

paragraphs: Saturday put 55 college games on the card, and it was a night for the 1.5-point heartbreak. Four different Overs missed by exactly 1.5: Temple's offense turned it over on downs at the UAB 17 instead of kicking a field goal, Oregon kicked a field goal from the Michigan 3 instead of scoring a touchdown, Auburn and Mississippi State sat at 50 points for the last 13:54, and a pick-six in overtime at Missouri State ended the game at 48. Louisville −3.5 took two knees at the North Carolina 12 and won by two. Miami −14 died on a backdoor touchdown with 21 seconds left, and NC State +3 turned into a push with 48 seconds left. After midnight, the Over 43.5 at San Diego State missed by half a point.

On the other side of the window, Texas +4.5 cashed on a touchdown with 3 seconds left, Northwestern +14 and the Over 45.5 cashed on the same touchdown with no time on the clock, and Alabama −14 survived a missed Vanderbilt field goal and a fourth-down stop to cash by one point.

Every game below is graded against the line printed on the card at kickoff, using ESPN finals and play-by-play, and a push counts as neither a hit nor a miss. Saturday's Lock It Up line moves count at their final lines. The heartbreakers go first, then the escapes, then Friday's two late finishes, Illinois at UCLA and Houston at Colorado, then the rest of the card.
Follow The Money had a side in 21 Saturday games and a total in 33, and In The Trenches had a side in 28 and no totals. Games without a pick aren't graded for them.

Card line: Louisville −3.5, total 57.5. The Cover Writer's card had Louisville −3.5 and the Under, projecting Louisville 30, North Carolina 25. Final: Louisville 16, North Carolina 14. Louisville won by 2, and the teams scored 30 points.

Louisville −3.5 holders had this one in the bag twice and dropped it twice. Hilbert's 36-yard field goal made it 16-7 with 7:28 left, a nine-point cushion with the clock running. Then Hall ran it in from 6 yards at 3:43, and at 16-14 every Louisville −3.5 ticket was losing by a point and a half.

Then the gift. Mack intercepted Burgess at the North Carolina 44 and brought it back 32 yards to the North Carolina 12 with under a minute left. A short field goal from there makes it 19-14, a five-point win, and Louisville −3.5 cashes. Kienholz took a knee, and then took another one. Louisville won by two, those two kneel-downs cost the cover, and Louisville −3.5 missed by 1.5. The Under 57.5 never broke a sweat at 30 points.
Called it: The Formula and Next Man Up on North Carolina +3.5, covered by 1.5 points. The Cover Writer, The Formula, Letdown Watch and Follow The Money on the Under 57.5, stayed under by 27.5 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, Letdown Watch and In The Trenches on Louisville −3.5, missed by 1.5 points. Next Man Up on the Over 57.5, fell 27.5 points short.
No pick: Follow The Money on the side; In The Trenches on the total.
Card line: Miami −14, total 54.5. The Cover Writer's card had Miami −14 and the Over, projecting Miami 35, Duke 20. Final: Duke 25, Miami 36. Miami won by 11, and the teams scored 61 points.

Miami −14 holders had this one cashed with four minutes left. Mallory's 39-yard touchdown run made it 36-17 at 4:21, a 19-point lead and five points to spare. The Over 54.5 sat at 53, needing one more score from anybody.

Duke went after both tickets. A 64-yard Duke touchdown came back on an illegal formation flag, and the Miami −14 crowd exhaled. Then the Miami defense handed Duke free yards at the goal: an illegal substitution flag, an offside flag, and another offside with 31 seconds left. Eget found Hasley from a yard out with 21 seconds left, and Sheppard caught the two-point throw. Miami won 36-25, by 11, so Miami −14 missed by 3, and the same backdoor touchdown carried the Over 54.5 home by 6.5. One snap, one ticket torn up, one ticket cashed.
Called it: Letdown Watch on Duke +14, covered by 3 points. The Cover Writer and Next Man Up on the Over 54.5, cleared it by 6.5 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on Miami −14, missed by 3 points. The Formula and Letdown Watch on the Under 54.5, went over by 6.5 points.
No pick: Follow The Money on the side or the total; In The Trenches on the side or the total.

Card line: Washington −2.5, total 44.5. The Cover Writer's card had Michigan State +2.5 and the Over, projecting Washington 24, Michigan State 22. Final: Washington 21, Michigan State 14. Washington won by 7, and the teams scored 35 points.

Michigan State +2.5 was cashing all through a 14-14 second half. Then the fourth quarter gave Michigan State two chances and it came up empty both times. A muffed Washington punt gave Michigan State the ball at the Washington 33, and Boyd's 50-yard field goal try missed at 10:26. Three points there and Michigan State +2.5 is sitting pretty.

Instead, Limar plunged in from a yard out with 2:24 left, and a tie game that was cashing became a seven-point hole. Michigan State's last drive died on a fumble at the Washington 41 with 35 seconds left. Washington won 21-14, Michigan State +2.5 missed by 4.5, and the Over 44.5 never got close at 35.
Called it: Letdown Watch and In The Trenches on Washington −2.5, covered by 4.5 points. Next Man Up on the Under 44.5, stayed under by 9.5 points.

Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula, Next Man Up and Follow The Money on Michigan State +2.5, missed by 4.5 points. The Cover Writer, The Formula, Letdown Watch and Follow The Money on the Over 44.5, fell 9.5 points short.

Card line: Missouri State −1.5, total 49.5. The Cover Writer's card had Missouri State −1.5 and the Over, projecting Missouri State 27, New Mexico State 23. Final: New Mexico State 21, Missouri State 27. Missouri State won by 6 in overtime, and the teams scored 48 points.

This is the one that keeps Over 49.5 holders up until Tuesday. Jones' 1-yard run made it 21-14 New Mexico State at 9:09, and Lair answered from 5 yards with 56 seconds left. Tied at 21, 42 points, and overtime. Overtime is where Overs go to cash: the Over 49.5 needed eight more, so two touchdowns, or a touchdown with a two-point try.

New Mexico State got the ball first and reached the Missouri State 15. Then Boamah intercepted Hedden at the 12 and returned it 88 yards for the game-ending touchdown. Game over, no kick. Missouri State won 27-21, so Missouri State −1.5 cashed by 4.5 on a pick-six, and the Over 49.5 missed by 1.5 on the same play.
Called it: The Cover Writer, The Formula, Next Man Up and Letdown Watch on Missouri State −1.5, covered by 4.5 points. Letdown Watch on the Under 49.5, stayed under by 1.5 points.

Card line: Temple −2.5, total 47.5. The Cover Writer's card had Temple −2.5 and the Over, projecting Temple 27, UAB 23. Final: UAB 36, Temple 10. UAB won by 26, and the teams scored 46 points.

Temple −2.5 was gone by the fourth quarter, so this one belongs to the Over 47.5 crowd, who got dragged to the doorstep and left there. Robinson ran 54 yards for a UAB touchdown at 8:20, and Rogers added a 5-yard run at 2:47. UAB 36, Temple 10: 46 points, one field goal short.

Temple went right down the field. Sheppard found Freeman for 16 yards to the UAB 20 and ran to the 17. Then three straight throws fell incomplete, the last one on fourth down for a turnover on downs with 1:17 left. A field goal from the 17 makes it 49 and cashes the Over. The Over 47.5 missed by 1.5, and the Under holders, Follow The Money among them, got paid by a team that never tried the kick.
Called it: Letdown Watch on UAB +2.5, covered by 28.5 points. Follow The Money on the Under 47.5, stayed under by 1.5 points.

Card line: Oregon −10.5, total 39.5. The Cover Writer's card had Oregon −10.5 and the Over, projecting Oregon 29, Michigan 15. Final: Michigan 7, Oregon 31. Oregon won by 24, and the teams scored 38 points.

Oregon −10.5 cashed easy. The Over 39.5 holders got to the Michigan 3 and got a field goal. Raiola's 49-yard touchdown throw to Hill made it 28-7 at 4:03, 35 points, and Oregon got the ball right back.

Hill ran to the Michigan 3 with 1:52 left, ran again for no gain, and a throw into the end zone fell incomplete. Hurych kicked a 21-yard field goal with 40 seconds left. Oregon 31, Michigan 7, 38 points. A touchdown there makes it 42 and cashes the Over. Hurych had also missed from 46 yards in the third quarter, and three more points anywhere would have done it. The Over 39.5 missed by 1.5.

Card line: Auburn −2.5, total 51.5. The Cover Writer's card had Mississippi State +2.5 and the Over, projecting Mississippi State 28, Auburn 24. Final: Auburn 41, Mississippi State 9. Auburn won by 32, and the teams scored 50 points.

Mississippi State +2.5 was over by halftime at 27-7. The Over 51.5 was the ticket still alive, and it stayed alive for a long time. Brown hit Singleton for a 42-yard touchdown at 5:52 of the third, and 41-7 put 48 on the board with a quarter and change to play.

Whitson dropped Mabson in the end zone for a safety at 13:54 of the fourth, and it was 50. Two points short with almost 14 minutes left. Then the scoreboard froze. Auburn won 41-9, Mississippi State +2.5 missed by 29.5, and the Over 51.5 missed by 1.5.

Marshall +1.5 needed only a field goal at the end, and couldn't get one. Diaz Nicolas' 24-yard field goal at 1:08 of the third had Marshall up 16-13. Then Hasselbeck ran 37 yards for an App State touchdown at 12:55, 20-16, and Marshall +1.5 was losing by 2.5.

Marshall forced a fumble at its own 16 at 9:36 and got the ball back again with 1:53 left. An App State offside flag moved it to the Marshall 47, and then four straight throws fell incomplete, the last for a turnover on downs at 1:12. A field goal makes it 20-19, a one-point loss, and Marshall +1.5 cashes. App State knelt it out. The Under 54.5 was never in doubt at 36.

Card line: Jacksonville State −7.5, total 54.5. The Cover Writer's card had Western Kentucky +7.5 and the Under, projecting Jacksonville State 30, Western Kentucky 23. Final: Jacksonville State 24, Western Kentucky 34. Western Kentucky won by 10, and the teams scored 58 points.

Western Kentucky +7.5 was fine all night. The Under 54.5 was the ticket that died at 0:00. It was 24-21 Jacksonville State from late in the second quarter into the final minute, 45 points, with the Under cashing by 9.5.

Glenn hit Rockwell from 10 yards with 2 seconds left, and the kick made it 28-24 Western Kentucky. 52 points, still under. Then, after the kickoff, Herard scored on a 2-yard fumble return as time ran out. 34-24, 58 points, and the Under 54.5 missed by 3.5 on a play that came after the game was already won. Western Kentucky +7.5 cashed by 17.5.

Card line: Syracuse −3, total 54.5. The Cover Writer's card had NC State +3 and the Under, projecting NC State 28, Syracuse 26. Final: Syracuse 34, NC State 31. Syracuse won by 3, and the teams scored 65 points.

NC State +3 was a winner with 48 seconds left, and the whole room was on it: the Cover Writer, The Formula, Next Man Up, Letdown Watch and In The Trenches all had NC State +3. Vinesett's 21-yard field goal made it 31-20 NC State at 6:55. Syracuse's Adeleye intercepted a throw and went 18 yards for a touchdown at 5:12, and the two-point try failed. 31-26, and that touchdown also sank the Under 54.5 at 57.

Then Angeli hit Ross-Simmons from 11 yards with 48 seconds left, and Ross-Simmons caught the two-point throw too. Syracuse 34, NC State 31. A three-point loss on a three-point line is a push. NC State still had a chance after Bailey ran 27 yards to the Syracuse 48, and then Bailey fumbled with 11 seconds left. NC State +3 pushed, and the Under 54.5 went over by 10.5.

paragraphs: Card line: LSU −4.5, total 46.5. The Cover Writer's card had Texas +4.5 and the Over, projecting LSU 25, Texas 24. Final: Texas 22, LSU 21. Texas won by 1, and the teams scored 43 points.

Texas +4.5 was losing by half a point for the last 11 minutes. Spetic's 50-yard field goal at 11:37 made it 21-16 LSU, a five-point game, and Texas +4.5 holders were half a point from home. Manning was intercepted by Pickett at the LSU 8 a minute later, and that looked like the end.

It came down to the last drive. Manning ran 7 yards to the LSU 4 with 9 seconds left and threw incomplete. Then he hit Brown from 4 yards out with 3 seconds left, and the two-point try failed. Texas 22, LSU 21. Texas +4.5 went from a half-point loser to a 5.5-point winner on the final snap. The Over 46.5 needed 47 and got 43, 3.5 short.
Called it: The Cover Writer, The Formula, Next Man Up and Letdown Watch on Texas +4.5, covered by 5.5 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula, Next Man Up and Letdown Watch on the Over 46.5, fell 3.5 points short.

Card line: Ohio State −14, total 45.5. The Cover Writer's card had Northwestern +14 and the Over, projecting Ohio State 30, Northwestern 19. Final: Northwestern 19, Ohio State 28. Ohio State won by 9, and the teams scored 47 points.

Northwestern +14 and the Over 45.5 were both losing with 65 seconds left. Fahey hit Smith for a 10-yard Ohio State touchdown at 6:33: 28-13, a 15-point lead, and 41 points on the board. Northwestern +14 was losing by a point, and the Over was 4.5 short.

Then Ohio State fumbled at the Northwestern 9 with 1:05 left, and Northwestern recovered at its own 16. Marchiol went to work: 18 yards to Wilde, 8 more, and then Dehnicke into Ohio State territory. After three straight incompletions, Marchiol hit Dehnicke for a 17-yard touchdown on the final play. No kick needed. Ohio State 28, Northwestern 19. Northwestern +14 cashed by 5 and the Over 45.5 cleared by 1.5 on the same snap, with no time on the clock. Follow The Money had Ohio State −14 and the Under 44.5, and lost both on that one play.

Card line: Alabama −14, total 47.5. The Cover Writer's card had Alabama −14 and the Over, projecting Alabama 35, Vanderbilt 18. Final: Alabama 21, Vanderbilt 6. Alabama won by 15, and the teams scored 27 points.

Alabama −14 holders spent the whole fourth quarter one Vanderbilt field goal from a miss. Russell's 9-yard touchdown throw to Brooks made it 21-6 at 7:13 of the third, a 15-point lead, and that is where the scoring stopped. Taylor had already hit from 52 and 57 yards, and he missed from 50 at 10:51 of the fourth.

Vanderbilt drove deep again, and a holding flag wiped out an 11-yard run to the Alabama 4. On fourth down at 3:40, Curtis threw incomplete into the end zone for a turnover on downs. Alabama won 21-6, and Alabama −14 cashed by one point. The Over 47.5 died at 27, 20.5 short.

Card line: Wisconsin −8.5, total 41.5. The Cover Writer's card had Maryland +8.5 and the Over, projecting Wisconsin 27, Maryland 20. Final: Wisconsin 21, Maryland 24. Maryland won by 3, and the teams scored 45 points.

The Over 41.5 needed a late touchdown and got one. Dupree's 1-yard run and the two-point throw made it 21-14 Wisconsin at 14:04, 35 points. Then neither team scored for almost 12 minutes. Williams hit Howard for a 39-yard touchdown at 2:11, 21-21, 42 points, and the Over 41.5 cashed right there.

Follow The Money's Under 42.5 was still alive at 42. Then Hopkins was sacked and fumbled, and Maryland recovered at the Wisconsin 33. O'Haire's 30-yard field goal with 29 seconds left won it 24-21 and killed that Under by 2.5. Maryland +8.5 cashed by 11.5, and the Over 41.5 cleared by 3.5.

Kansas State +13.5 was dead at 17-0 and came back to life. Rodriguez hit a 55-yard field goal, and Duff found Tibbs for a 53-yard touchdown with 48 seconds left in the third. 17-10. Lemmermann's 36-yard field goal at 10:15 made it 20-10, a 10-point lead, and Kansas State +13.5 holders spent the last 10 minutes praying TCU didn't find four more points.
Duff was sacked and fumbled at the TCU 42 with 1:58 left, and TCU recovered. TCU knelt it out. TCU won 20-10, Kansas State +13.5 cashed by 3.5, and the Over 44.5 got 30, 14.5 short.

No pick: Follow The Money on the side; In The Trenches on the side or the total.

hits.heading: Part 1, continued: The week's W-L and smack talk

paragraphs: The Cover Writer went 31-20-1 against the spread and 22-30 on totals Saturday, and that runs the week to 38-24-1 against the spread and 27-36 on totals. Texas +4.5 on the last snap, Northwestern +14 and the Over 45.5 on a touchdown with no time on the clock, and Alabama −14 by a single point. That's a side card that can walk into any room. The totals card is another story: four Overs missed by exactly 1.5, and the Over 43.5 at San Diego State missed by half a point. Friday's two late games went Illinois +10 and Colorado +10, both cashed, while the Over at UCLA and the Under at Colorado both lost.

The Formula went 28-23-1 against the spread and 22-30 on totals Saturday, 34-28-1 and 27-36 for the week. It rode the same four 1.5-point Over misses, plus the Over 43.5 at San Diego State by half a point, and only Alabama −14 by one point and the Over 45.5 at Ohio State on the final play kept the night from getting uglier. Above water on sides, under water on totals, and nobody needs to hear about it.

Next Man Up went 31-20-1 against the spread and 29-23 on totals Saturday, 34-28-1 and 33-30 for the week. The worst side mark in the room on Friday is back over .500. Next Man Up took the Over 54.5 at Western Kentucky and cashed on a fumble return as time ran out, took San Diego State +3 and the Under 43.5, and cashed both, and it'll tell you that was the plan all along.

Letdown Watch went 34-17-1 against the spread and 23-29 on totals Saturday, 38-24-1 and 31-32 for the week. Best side day in the room, and it's tied with the Cover Writer for the week's side mark. The totals mark that everybody was chasing on Friday? It got caught.

Follow The Money went 8-13 against the spread and 20-17 on totals Saturday, 10-14 and 23-18 for the week. It had Ohio State −14 and the Under 44.5 and lost both on one touchdown with no time on the clock. Then it had Vanderbilt +14 and lost by one point. The late Overs at Texas Tech and Wyoming cashed, and the Over 44.5 at San Diego State did not. The money moved; the money got burned, then got some back.

In The Trenches went 14-15-1 against the spread and made no total picks Saturday, 17-19-1 for the week, still with no totals. Louisville −3.5 lost on two kneel-downs at the North Carolina 12, and Marshall +1.5 lost on a fourth-down incompletion. San Diego State +3 and UTSA +2.5 cashed late. Close calls count the same as blowouts in the record, and the trenches know it.
